entities.name: Holy Family Cathedral, Banjarmasin
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Holy Family Cathedral is a religious building of the Catholic Church in Banjarmasin in the province of South Kalimantan, Indonesia. It was designed by architect Roestenhurg in a neo-Gothic style.
